basic_info.description: This home stands out! Step into a tunnel entrance style home that has been fully converted to indoor living space. This expanded, reimagined residence is truly stunning and efficient, as it has been thoughtfully redesigned. It features 3 bedrooms, 2 luxury baths, an entertainment/recreation room, a remodeled, gorgeous kitchen and adjoining dining area that includes lovely banquette w/ storage. Extended primary bedroom has a walk-out deck and built-in closet organizers. Newer ensuite bedroom w/ bath is located on the lower level. Original charm and details have been preserved. High tech and smart home components have been added for modern living and convenience. Outdoor lover's backyard oasis features a spacious patio for lounging, fully equipped outdoor kitchen, hot tub and pretty, landscaped garden. Multiple skylights allow light to shine throughout. There are a variety of smart home features throughout, of which many are controllable via phone apps. 24-hour video surveillance with pre-installed cameras. Ideal location, close to Stern Grove Park, Lake Merced, Stonestown and Lakeshore Shopping Centers, Lowell High School, St. Stephens Grade School, Lakeshore Elementary School, State University and 280 Freeway.
